scheme_name: Grant to Meritorious Wards of Ex-Servicemen in Academics (Lump Sum Grant)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a ward of an Ex‑Serviceman or a ward of the widow of an Ex‑Serviceman

Applicant must have secured 1st, 2nd or 3rd rank in Class 10th or 12th in a government‑recognized institution, or must have secured a gold medal in graduation/post‑graduation from a government‑recognized university
Application must be submitted within three months from the date of publication of the exam result
benefits_summary: Lump‑sum grant of up to ₹18,000 is provided based on academic rank and level of education.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
